messages:
emma: Heads-up — Support ticket: Patron org reporting hourly usage graphs are ~3 hours behind for the last 6 hours. Multiple customers pinging. cc @raj @liam :alarm_clock:

raj: On it. Seen any pattern? single tenant or cross-tenant?

emma: Mostly Patron tenant, but small blips for a couple of tenants in same region. Console shows last processed hourly window at 03:00 UTC, current time 06:15 UTC.

liam: Could be the Kinesis consumer group that feeds the hourly ETL. I saw a spike in incoming records ~02:50-03:20 UTC earlier today.

maya: I pulled the consumer lag dashboard — consumer cg-etl-hourly has a sustained lag from that window, peaked ~120k records. Retention on that stream is 24h so shouldn't drop messages yet.

raj: Any deploys around 02:40-03:10?

liam: No infra deploys. We had an autoscale event on the ETL cluster at 02:55 (scale-up) that triggered throttling on the worker side while new pods joined. Might be connection churn + kinesis burst = backlog.

emma: Support needs a customer-facing ETA. Can we repro or provide a workaround?

maya: Short term: re-run the hourly backfill job for Patron with --from=2024-09-14T02:00Z --to=2024-09-14T06:00Z. That job id is etl-backfill-? I can kick if we want.

raj: Before we backfill, confirm there are no duplicate-upsert risks. What does the job dedupe on?

liam: Dedup key is (tenant_id, window_start, metric_type). Backfill is idempotent. Also check S3 manifests — if upload manifest got delayed, the aggregator would miss windows.

maya: Quick check: S3 manifest ingestion times: I see a ~3h gap in manifest arrival timestamps for the Patron prefix between 02:55 and 03:30 UTC. That matches the consumer lag window.

raj: Sounds like Kinesis burst → consumer lag → manifests delayed → hourly aggregator sees empties. Root cause likely kinesis ingestion spike. Do we have producer logs for that time?

liam: I pulled producer app logs for patron-ingest-prod: multiple retries at 02:48-02:52 and a downstream batch size increase. Might have been a client-side retry storm after a regional S3 hiccup.

emma: OK. Actionable items: 1) maya to kick backfill for Patron windows 02:00-06:00 UTC, 2) raj to create postmortem draft with timeline, 3) liam to add Kinesis consumer autoscaling guard (limit connection churn). Support message: tell customers ETA ~1 hour and that we are backfilling.

maya: Backfill started: job etl-backfill-179999-Patron-1, tracking URL: https://etl-console/jobs/etl-backfill-179999-Patron-1. Initial estimate ~40m.

sre-bot: ETL backfill job etl-backfill-179999-Patron-1 started at 1800000050. Logs streaming at https://logs.internal/etl-backfill-179999-Patron-1

raj: I'll draft the timeline and include Kinesis metrics + producer retry traces. Assigning follow-ups to eng-infra for throttling policy change.

emma: Thanks all. I'll update the customers: "we're running backfill, dashboards should be updated within ~1hr, root cause investigation in progress." :+1:

liam: Follow-up note — after backfill completes, we should verify the aggregator's watermark advancement and check that no synthetic 0-row windows were written. If we see zeros, we may need to re-run with include-empty-windows=false.

maya: Backfill progress: 30% after 12m, no errors so far.

emma: Closing loop later. If anything unexpectedly fails, ping #eng-oncall and paste job id.
